author: Kevin Kelly
short: Shared setup, health, and safe server settings backups.
description: An optional requester-bound settings dashboard for loaded AudioPlus, CommunityPlus, LevelPlus, LogPlus, and OwoPlus cogs. Open existing setup panels, inspect health and local music prerequisites, export selected server configuration, and preview validated same-server restores while preserving member records. Includes shared theme controls, permission-aware command search, diagnostic downloads, and opt-in automatic settings snapshots with comparison and previewed restoration.
install_msg: Load with [p]load settingshub and open [p]settings. All controls require administrator access or Manage Server. Use [p]settings health or [p]settings backup. Enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog settingshub, then [p]slash sync. See the README for backup scope and restoration.
end_user_data_statement: Stores server theme preferences and up to ten bounded configuration snapshots per server. Snapshots exclude member records, message histories, credentials and runtime cursors. Requester IDs and restore previews are kept in memory for up to three minutes. Files and messages posted to Discord remain managed there.
